alerts.reason: GameStop’s consolidated net sales swung from +21.78% year over year in August to −4.57% in November, just 0.43 percentage points above the threshold (A). U.S. and Australian sales growth of 11.8% and 23.3% could keep the intervening quarter above −5.00%. With European sales down 45.7% and Canadian sales down 100% (B), even a modest weakening of that offset could push the quarter beginning February 1 to −5.00% or below.
